Leah (Marketing): Idea: 30m micro-demo + benchmark post + 60 starter credits. Target: dev leads who tried the console.
Omar (Growth): Keep it hands-on: 3 prompts, 1-click run, immediate credit grant on checklist.
Tess (Product): We'll surface 3 prompt templates in the UI during the demo and show token & latency estimates.
Mina (Onboarding): Proposed credit split: 20 unlocked at signup, 40 after completing 2 checklist steps. Reduces abuse.
Kai (Ops): Route demo traffic to `demo-pool-small`, set fallback to hosted. Add soft qps limit.
Leah (Marketing): Landing headline draft: "Ship an LLM feature in 30 minutes + 60 credits" Short supporting line and sign-up CTA.
Omar (Growth): Experiment plan: Variant A (60 upfront), B (20+40 gated). Holdout 25% for baseline. Track activation, 7-day usage, cost/user.
Tess (Product): Prompt packs: "Launch social post", "Code explain", "Support snippet". Each has 2 starters and a tweak tip.
Mina (Onboarding): Checklist: 1) create API key, 2) run a prompt. Completion flips `credits_unlocked=true`.
Kai (Ops): Pseudo config:
```
cohort: micro-apr26
pool: demo-pool-small
max_qps: 60
fallback: hosted-core
```
Leah (Marketing): Promo channels: in-app banner, email to recent signups, small LinkedIn push. Blog benchmark same day.
Omar (Growth): Metrics: landing CVR, attendance %, first-run rate, weekly retention. Also monitor token burn during demo.
Mina (Onboarding): UI: show credit balance in modal after unlock. Less support friction.
Tess (Product): I'll own modal UX and instrument per-prompt telemetry.
Kai (Ops): Credit expiry: 30 days, per-user cap 100 from this promo. Org-level guard: max 3 grantees.
